headline: Gold and silver fell sharply today, with 24K gold at ₹12,557 per gram
summary: Today's change is a fall of ₹512 per gram for 24K gold (down 3.92% from ₹13,069 on 19 November) and ₹5,000 per kg for silver (down 2.78%). Over the last 7 days 24K gold is down 8.58% and silver is down 10.26%, and across the 26 days since 26 October gold has fallen 12.04% and silver 20.45%. Possible drivers include a firmer US dollar against the rupee and softer international prices, though the app's data does not confirm the cause.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery or coins, compare the making charges and GST across shops, since the base rate has dropped quickly and a further move in either direction is possible; this is general information, not financial advice.
